tagline: Premier independent ultra-low carbon intensity natural gas development, production, midstream and technology company centered in the Appalachian Basin
hero_kpi_rationale: Total Sales Volumes is the key indicator of the company's production and growth, reflecting its ability to develop its natural gas, NGL and oil resources in the Appalachian Basin.

kpis.name: Total Sales Volumes
kpis.explanation: Volume of natural gas, NGL and oil sold
kpis.description: Indicator of the company's production and growth

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Company's net income including unrealized gains/losses on derivative instruments
kpis.description: Indicator of the company's net profitability

kpis.short: Natural Gas, NGL and Oil Production Costs
kpis.name: Natural Gas, NGL and Oil Production Costs
kpis.explanation: Direct production costs including lease operating expense, ad valorem taxes, transportation, gathering, compression and production DD&A
kpis.description: Indicator of direct natural gas, NGL and oil production costs
kpis.signal: Increase in production costs in absolute terms, stability at the unit level

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $2.239 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $3.98 in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total assets of $9.094 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Stockholders Equity
kpis.description: Stockholders' equity extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Stockholders' equity of $4.337 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Price Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on natural gas prices, which can significantly impact its revenues and profitability. Price volatility is beyond CNX's control.

risks.title: Operational Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to operational risks such as accidents, equipment failures and breakdowns, which could negatively impact its operations.

risks.title: Environmental Regulations
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental regulations, which could significantly impact its costs and operations.

risks.title: Demand Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on natural gas demand, which can significantly affect its revenues and profitability.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to its contracts and relationships with customers and suppliers.

risks.title: Competitive Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces increasing competition in the energy sector, which could negatively impact its market share and revenues.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks related to the protection of its data and systems.
